about: measure contests of 2024 in Indiana, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

in_enr.name: Indiana Election Division, Indiana Election Results, November 2024 General Election (the results site's archive)
in_enr.licence: no licence printed; the page's footer reads 'Copyright 1989 - <year>. Quest Information Systems, Inc. All Rights Reserved.' (the site's maker); the counts are the state's certified results
in_enr.note: the state's results files, marked certified in its settings ('Certified': 'T'); 119 JSON files (the 116 office and county files 5,460,060 bytes), read by pipeline/intake/in_enr.py; the site lists no write-in totals

question.title: Public Question #1
question.subject: Shall The Constitution Of The State Of Indiana Be Amended To Remove The State Superintendent Of Public Instruction From The List Of Officeholders Who Shall Discharge The Powers And Duties Of The Governor If The Office Of The Governor And Lieutenant Governor Are Both Vacant?

threshold.rule: majority of the electors voting on the amendment. Read through WebFetch, not curl: the iga.in.gov PDF returns a JavaScript shell to curl, headless Chromium was given HTML for the page's own scripts, and Justia's copy answered 403 (a bot check); the quote is WebFetch's verbatim text of section 1(c), not checked against a saved page
threshold.quote: If a majority of the electors voting on the amendment ratify the amendment, the amendment becomes a part of this Constitution.
threshold.read_via: WebFetch (curl got a JavaScript page; the quote is WebFetch's text, not checked against a saved page)
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (amendment)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test of statewide measures shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (11 against 6.8 within 1 point of ½, and 10 against 6.2 within 20,000 votes, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low
